appName.message: Proxy Switcher & Manager: HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 Proxy with Auth

appDescription.message: Switch between HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5 proxies in one click. Save logins, test every proxy and set bypass rules. No account, no ads.

status_controlled_other_hint.message: Resolve the conflict below, or disable the other proxy extension in chrome://extensions.

status_not_controllable_hint.message: They are managed by your administrator or system policy

auth_failed.message: The proxy rejected the username or password

empty_text.message: Add a proxy server once and switch to it with a single click.

paste_hint.message: Paste a full proxy string like user:pass@host:port into Host to fill every field

socks_auth_unsupported.message: Chrome doesn't support authentication for SOCKS proxies.

bypass_hint.message: These hosts connect directly. One per line; wildcards like *.example.com and <local> work.

error_tunnel_failed.message: The proxy refused to open the connection. Check the credentials and that it allows HTTPS.

error_proxy_unreachable.message: Can't connect to the proxy server. Check the host and port.

error_proxy_certificate.message: The proxy's TLS certificate is invalid.

error_timeout.message: The proxy didn't respond in time.

error_settings_locked.message: Proxy settings are controlled by another extension or a policy, so the proxy can’t be tested.

conflict_candidates_hint.message: Enabled extensions with proxy permission are listed below. Chrome does not identify the owner. Choose which extension to disable; it stays disabled until you enable it again in chrome://extensions.

conflict_no_candidates.message: No enabled proxy extensions found. Review chrome://extensions and browser policies.

conflict_action_failed.message: Could not change extension control. Check permissions or open chrome://extensions.

error_apply_failed.message: Chrome could not apply or restore the proxy settings. Try again.

error_verification_failed.message: No check service could be reached through the configured proxy. The connection is not verified; it will be checked again automatically.

error_no_probe_route.message: The bypass rules send all check services directly. Adjust the rules to verify this connection.

error_test_busy.message: Another proxy check is running. Try again when it finishes.

error_test_cancelled.message: The proxy settings changed during the check. Test again.

error_test_routing.message: A separate test cannot preserve the current system, automatic or complex bypass routing. Save the proxy, then turn it on to verify the actual connection.
